# Melonite

> Melonite supervises coding-agent Work sessions with durable rule sets, task-specific watchers, proof, and editable follow-up prompts.

## Documentation

- [Product manual](https://melonite.ai/manual.md): Concise product concepts and operating instructions in Markdown.
- [Product manual for humans](https://melonite.ai/manual/): The same manual rendered as a web page.

## Full text

- [llms-full.txt](https://melonite.ai/llms-full.txt): The complete product manual in one text file.
